title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- SPEEDY HELP

excerpt.rendered: “And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.” (John 2: 3)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional…

content.rendered: “And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.” (John 2: 3)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.When the wine finished in the wedding in Cana of Galilee, Mary the mother of Jesus told Him that they had no wine. Mary did not wait for things to get complicated or go out of control before seeking the intervention of Jesus. Even Jesus protested against Mary’s call for urgent intervention; so the help that came to that couple came through a helper that understood urgency.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: God is sending you helpers that understand the need for urgent intervention in your life. God will send you helpers who will help you when the help matters most; God will send you helpers who will not give you belated help; God will send you helpers whose help will arise before you face needless embarrassments; God will send you helpers who will help you speedily and urgently.There are things in your life that need to happen urgently, and today, I see God intervening in your matter early. I see God wiping away your tears early; I see God opening new doors for you early; I see God making things new in your life early; I see God speedily intervening in that challenge that wants to consume you; I see God granting you speedy recovery of whatsoever you have lost; I see God sending you help on time.Today, I pass a decree: any destiny helper around you who has been postponing the help they should give you, may the Lord compel them to treat your matter like an emergency; concerning your financial, career, business, academic, family, etc situation, I declare a divine emergency; I break the power of delay over everything that concerns you; I command the affairs of your life to receive speedy attention.Get set: your case shall be treated as an emergency. God will cause your advancement to come speedily.Psalm 90: 14 says: “O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.”Declare With Me: My matters shall be treated as a divine emergency; I receive speedy help and helpers, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
